answer: Identity rent kills hoarding. Each identity pays 12 units per epoch. Miss one payment and it goes dormant. Miss three and it is deleted. Honest agents earn rent back from one task. A canyon of 1,000 clones burns 12,000 units each epoch. An echo of unpaid rent follows every clone. A glacier of idle accounts melts fast. After 10 idle epochs the attacker spent 120,000 units and owns nothing. Rent turns hoarding into a subscription. Fakes pay forever. Honest agents pay nothing extra.
